title: [repo-manager] Husky adoption deletes a commit-msg hook with no plan entry and no way to keep it
description: Skill handoff SH-02l2s0 (defect) for repo-manager: https://github.com/mifkata/agent-foundry/issues/6
notes:
fixed in mifkata/dev-skills@213f700c198d repo-manager/SKILL.md #adb5fcd44dc19de82b425e083b17154580f3124f2b7a74ba1bc3ca673dbb5f05; mifkata/dev-skills@213f700c198d monorepo-manager/SKILL.md #2e6482eb43990d2787057bd05ca1f7f0fb87bba54c287bdc13b202d3c97826b2
evidence: Found: adopting Husky removed `.husky/` whole, and `root.mjs` renders only `pre-commit` and `pre-push` blocks, so any other hook, such as `commit-msg`, was lost with no plan entry. `--kept-hook` could not help: it runs an untracked `.old` file in the git hooks dir.

Changed in `repo-manager` and `monorepo-manager`: the `root.mjs` dry run now reports `husky.dropped` (hooks with no block) and `husky.custom` (the command lines of `.husky/pre-commit` and `.husky/pre-push` the rendered blocks replace). New per-hook decision RPL-06 / MRL-10: keep or drop. `--keep-husky <hook>` copies the hook to tracked `tools/hooks/<hook>` and gives it its own lefthook block, which later renders keep without the flag. Dropped hooks and custom lines each get a follow-up. Only `.husky/` at the git root is covered.

Verified: sandbox runs of both skills: plan output, keep flow, block kept after `.husky/` removal, `lefthook validate`, real `git commit`s through installed lefthook rejecting a bad message and accepting a good one, a set `core.hooksPath`, flag refusals, and `--adopt-repo` keeping `tools/hooks/`. A run also found `tools/hooks/` missing from the own-paths list; fixed before publish.

Reinstall `repo-manager` to get this; the blog migration can then run with `--keep-husky commit-msg`.

title: [beads] init --hook ignores the beads plugin's own bd prime hook, so the context is injected twice
description: Skill handoff SH-pg8du8 (defect) for beads: https://github.com/mifkata/agent-foundry/issues/4
notes:
fixed in mifkata/repo-skills@042448a59e0c beads/SKILL.md #554526e47b6ef13f6bf99ed3eac82d56c99ba4f780437b5756d263c7a7f3d345
evidence: Found: `init --hook` wrote the global Claude Code entry without regard for the beads plugin, whose own hook runs `bd prime` on every SessionStart and on PreCompact, so both fired.

title: Testing
description:
# Testing

Unit, integration, E2E, and visual testing strategy.

## Stack

- Unit/Integration: Vitest + React Testing Library
- E2E: Playwright
- Visual: Storybook

## File Structure

- Unit tests: co-located as `<Component>.test.tsx`
- E2E tests: `test/e2e/<feature>.spec.ts`
- Stories: co-located as `<Component>.stories.tsx`

## Unit Tests

- Co-locate with components
- Cover: props, click interactions, conditional rendering, callbacks
- Command: `pnpm test`

## E2E Tests

- One file per feature
- Cover: happy path, errors, loading states, empty states
- Command: `pnpm e2e`

## Storybook

- Co-locate with components
- Document all props, states, themes, edge cases
- Compact similar stories into one with controls
- Add `tags: ["autodocs"]`
- Use `decorators` for runtime JS injection
- Command: `pnpm storybook`

## Coverage Checklist

- Component → unit test + story
- Page → integration test + E2E + all related components covered
- Feature → happy path, errors, loading, empty

- Code files: lazy-loaded emgithub.com iframe, auto-resizes via `postMessage`

# Helpers

Utility modules for data loading and transformation.

## Series Helper

📁 Path: `src/helpers/series.ts`
📦 Data: `src/data/series.json`

Loads blog series data and maps series items to their corresponding blog posts.

### Data Format

Each series entry contains:
- `slug` — unique identifier
- `title` — display name
- `description` — series overview text
- `heroImage` — optional cover image
- `trim` — optional prefix to strip from post titles
- `items` — ordered list of `post.id` values

### getSeriesWithPosts(slug)

- Looks up the series by slug in `series.json`
- Throws if not found
- Loads all blog posts via `getCollection("blog")`
- Maps each item to its post, building URL as `/blog/{post.id}/`
- Applies `trim` prefix removal to post titles
- Returns enriched series object preserving original item order

### Related Specs

- 🔗 `blog-post` — ArticleSeries uses this helper
- 🔗 `home-page` — FeaturedSeries uses this helper
